digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler inbound link diffing and application
propositions: The inbound link differ is ADD-only by construction and never removes local deps when peer links are deleted in Jira, while the outbound direction has a removal path, creating asymmetry.
A link deleted in Jira persists forever on the local rebar ticket with no removal record emitted or applied, failing the J11 mutation table oracle that the local dep must be ABSENT.
The apply layer silently discards removal records via an `action != 'add'` guard, so even if the differ emits a removal, it is never executed as an unlink operation.

Safe arbitration between inbound removal and outbound addition requires historical signal (prior peer link set from binding baseline) to distinguish a peer deletion from a never-pushed local link, preventing data loss on brand-new deps.

The feature must gate on positive observation of the peer's issuelinks field (key present, empty list allowed) to prevent failed enrichment and truncated reads from triggering removals that destroy managed local deps.
